name: Yoshinoya Seine
source:
Seine is a very quiet girl who's in her second year of high school. She loves pets and can usually be found with the cat that seems to live at the school. She also loves drama but is unable to show any emotions so normally practices by herself.

Consequently, people struggle in interacting with her and end up avoiding her. She is interested in theatre, but doesn’t know where to start since she’s bad around people. As a result, she continues to practice alone on a regular basis. Seine also loves food, animals, and otaku subculture.

[From [url=https://liemyx.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/lovelyxcation-2-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url]] & [From [url=http://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2013/06/03/three-way-review-lovely-x-cation-2/comment-page-1/]Amaenbou Dane~[/url]]
